bribe.why: threatened, he goes to the police
lines: I'm sorry, but I can't be frightened into silence. I think I'll be having a word with the police.
Sorry, I do go on. What I mean is, no, and the station will hear of it.

bribe.why: leverage makes him uneasy, not bought
lines: Oh dear. I'd rather not say anything either way, and I'm sorry, that sounds worse than it is.
Give me a day, would you? I walk the quay at ten. I'll know my own mind by then.
You're asking me to look the other way for good, and I'm sorry, but no. I couldn't.
That's rather more than a favour, isn't it? I teach, or I did. I can't pretend.

bribe.why: plain decent neighbour, not for sale
lines: I don't take money for what I've seen, Frank. Sorry, that sounds pompous. It's simply how it is.
Keep it. And forgive me for saying, but I'd think hard about whatever it was.

threat.why: folds when his own deed is named
lines: You know about Grace's window? I never... right, alright. Just say what you want me to do.
Don't tell Danny, yeah? I never meant it to go this far. I'll sort it.
Alright, alright! Keep your hands off me. I'll do it, I never said I wouldn't.
I'll pay, I'll sort it. Just don't come round my gran's, yeah?

threat.why: too big for him, runs to Danny
lines: I can't, honest. That's not mine to give. Danny'd have me. I'll have to ask him.
I never said no. I just need a word with the crew first.
Pay you? I never owed you nothing. Clear off, I've got mates.
You don't scare me. I never did nothing, and you can't prove it.
I never said I wouldn't. But what's in it for me, though? Eh?
Make it worth my while and I'll think about it. I'm not daft.
Information is stock like any other, and I price stock. That sort of money starts a conversation.
I'll tell you what I choose. What it's worth is my business, not yours.

inform.why: menace buys nothing across the grille
lines: Threats don't price well in here. There's a grille between us for a reason.
Lean on my window and you'll find it lit late and watched.

inform.why: a tie is only a tie
lines: Mickey's name opens a door a crack. It doesn't empty my books. Come back with something.
I'm doing my books. Ask me again when you've something to put on the counter.

inform.why: wants far more than she'd ever sell
lines: You want me to give up Danny's business? I never said what a thing is worth. And not that.
No price covers that. Thirty years behind this grille, and I'm still here.

inform.why: gives nothing, says she knows nothing
lines: I price rings and watches, not people. I know nothing about it.
You've the wrong shop. Now, if you've something to pawn, I'll look at it.

false_authority.why: nerve high, will not be bullied
lines: Don't come the heavy with me. Nobody's told me a thing about you.
The Widow tells me who comes on the dock. She never mentioned you.
So the Widow sent you, did she? I'll want that from her mouth, not yours.
Wait there. I'll check. Might be a while, mind, ha.
Everyone's got a boss till it's time to pay. Show me the colour and we'll see.
Porters' cut's the porters' cut. Make it worth my while and the yard's yours.

false_authority.why: too big a claim, checks upstairs
lines: The cold-store yard? Not on your say-so. I'll have a word upstairs and see who's expected.
Might be you are, might not. I'm not risking my cut on a stranger's word.

false_authority.why: pretends to wave him through while stalling
lines: Oh aye, I've heard of you. Just not today. Come back when the yard's quieter.
No one's rung about you. Funny, that. Go on, off you pop.
I knew Mickey forty years. Sit down and I'll tell you what I saw, and when.
Mind, I'll say it once. Tea's not offered twice in this house.

witness.why: not frightened, rings the night desk
lines: You'll not frighten me at my own window. The night desk will hear of you.
I see everything on this street, young man. Including you, just now.
I'm not for sale. Keep your money, I've no use for it.
Forty years I've sat here. I'll say what I saw, but not for payment.

witness.why: will not say what she did not see
lines: I saw what I saw. I'll not say what I didn't, and I'll not guess.
You're asking for more than I know. I'll not make it up for you.

witness.why: tells what she saw if told why
lines: I'll tell you what I saw if you tell me what you're about.
I keep this window, and I keep what I see. Convince me first.
Mickey's name still counts with me. I'm on the set from six. Tell me what you need.
Twenty years of nights for the firm. I'll not leave it short.
Twenty years of nights. Nobody's leant on me yet, and you'll not be the first.
Don't. I've said nowt to anyone and I'll say nowt to you.

recruit.why: money not the draw but he listens
lines: Money's not what keeps me out here. But say what the job is.
I sleep days. If it's nights, I'm listening. If it's not, I'm not.
That's not driving, and I'm a driver. No.
I do nights. Twenty years of them. I don't do that.
I'll think on it. I sleep days, ask me when I'm up.
Few words, me. Ask me properly on the set, from six.

debt.why: scared, pays in what he hears
lines: Alright, alright, so listen. I've not got the twenty-two, but I've got something better.
I'll tell you what I hear, everything. Just ease off, yeah?
So listen. Mickey was good to me. Course I'll make it right, I always do.
I owe the book twenty-two and I'll pay it. In what I hear, mind.
So listen, give me a bit of work and I'll clear the twenty-two. Messages, watching a door.
Any money you put my way, I'll take off the debt. Fair?
Twenty-two I can do in what I hear. More than that? No chance, I'm skint.
So listen, I haven't got it. I hang about the parade, I hear things. That's all.
So listen, I haven't got the twenty-two, but I know things. Fair swap?
I'll pay you back in what I hear, Frank. Ask me who's skint and who's flush.
Try it. My father opened this caff in 1936 and nobody's had a penny off us.
I forget nobody, Frank. You come in here like that, I'll remember it a long time.

squeeze.why: feeds first, fended off with warmth
lines: Mickey ate here. That's not the same as me paying you. Sit down, eat, and we'll see.
Sit. You're thin. I'll hear you after you've had something.

squeeze.why: she hears everything and will use it
lines: Whatever you think you hold, I hear it all over breakfast. Don't come the clever with me.
I've half the street in here at six. You'd do well to remember that.
Protection from what? Don't be daft. This is my father's caff, and it stays free.
You ask me for that, and I'll tell you where to put it. Politely.
Protection from what? Sit down and eat, Frank, and stop talking daft.
I pay for nothing but what I eat. Now, what'll you have?
Now you're talking! Danny never paid like that. When do I start?
Ha! Say no more. I'm yours. Just tell me where and when.
Not bad, not bad. Make it more and I'm listening.
Danny's lot's my lot. But money talks, mate. Louder, though.
Don't try that on me. I've seen harder men than you, ha!
You think I'm scared? Go on then. Danny'd laugh.
Walk out on Danny and take the lot with me? Do one!
Not even for double. I've done my share with that crew.

poach.why: wants the offer in his hand
lines: Danny's lot's my lot. Ha! But go on, make me an offer.
I'm not saying no. Not saying yes either. Let's hear it.

police.why: threat to an officer is an offence
lines: Threatening an officer is an offence, sir. I'll be reporting this to the station.
I'd advise you to say no more, sir. This will go on record.
That sounds very like an attempt to bribe a constable, sir. I'll pretend I didn't hear it.
I can't take that, sir. Take it back, and we'll say no more.
I'm aware of Mr Suddaby, sir, but that doesn't alter my duty.
I do things by the book, sir. I'm sorry.

police.why: asked to set duty aside entirely
lines: I can't do that at all, sir. It isn't a thing I'm able to do.
You're asking me to neglect my duty, sir. I won't.
I'm sorry, sir, I can't. It would have to be done by the book.
Three years in uniform, sir, and I intend to keep it clean.
Earn it. I promised Mickey I'd size up whoever inherited. I'm still sizing.
The book is kept. Show me what you do with the office first.
Raise your voice to me and I'm on the bus. The book stays where it is.
I don't repeat myself. Lower your voice.
I'm not for sale. Put that away.
Thirty-one years, and no one's bought the red book yet.
That's not yours to ask. Not yet, and not from me.
No.
The red book is kept. I'll not say where. Ask me again when I trust you.
I'll not explain twice. Once is asked, once is answered.
You can't frighten what's sworn, Frank. I'll pray for you, that's all I can do.
What was said stays with God. I'll say no more, and no threat will change it.
There's no sum, son. What was said stays between a man and God.
Keep your money. Put it where it does some good.

seal.why: trust is why he keeps it
lines: Mickey trusted me with it. That's exactly why I'll not speak.
I buried him three weeks ago. I'll keep his word as I kept him.
You ask the one thing I can never give, son. Not for anyone.
No, Frank. Not now, not ever. Come in and sit, if you need to talk.
I can't tell you that, Frank. But come in and sit a while if you want.
I listen more than I talk. What I hear, I keep.
Threats won't work on me. I'll see someone about this.
I'll take advice, thank you. And I'd keep your temper if I were you.
I don't want the office. Draw up what you need and I'll sign.
Keep your money. If it's reasonable, I'll sign and be done.

claim.why: wants proof of her father's wishes
lines: You say Mickey wanted you to have it. Then show me where he said so.
Put it in writing. Then we'll see what I'm giving up.
I'm sorting his things at Regent House. Those I decide on myself.
The office, perhaps. His things, no. That isn't yours to ask.
I want nothing from the office. Ask me again when I've finished with his things.
I've no date to leave. I'll answer you when I'm ready.
Put it in my hand and I'll page it. The box will ring back within the half hour.
That's the right sort of money, Frank. Leave the rest with me.
A start. I talk for money, not gossip. More, and the meeting happens.
Friendly to everyone, me. Friendly costs. Make it worth the page.

broker.why: rough does not buy a meeting
lines: Rough doesn't buy a meeting. I'm friendly with all three sides, and I keep it that way.
Lean on me and I stop being friendly. And then no one meets anyone.
One truce is all I sell, and I'll not sell a miracle.
That's beyond me, Frank. I'll not promise what I can't page.

broker.why: wants a name and a fee
lines: Come with a fee and a name, and I'll see who answers my page.
I never say a name I've not been paid to say. Friendly, but careful.

plant.why: blabs on, passes to the Widow
lines: Me? I'm a vault, Frank. Right, I'd best get on, car one's waiting.
Eight years in that seat, I've learned to keep quiet. Mostly.

plant.why: wants to be asked, passes it round
lines: Leave it with me, Frank. I'll make sure folk hear it right.
Wouldn't want the office to shut, would we? I'll keep my ear open.
Fares being what they are, a bit extra wouldn't hurt. Go on then, what's the tale?
Weather's rotten, fares are worse. Make it worth my while and I'll mention it.
That's too big a one for me to carry, Frank. Folk'd never swallow it.
Wouldn't touch that one. Fares are bad enough without it.
Go on then, I'll mention it. Not that I'm one for talking, mind.
Moaning's all I'm good for. But I'll let it slip, if you like.
